tagline: 潘泰康胶片单反相机，1976 年发布
description: 潘泰康于1976年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度Focal plane shutter made of steel lamellae, with speeds 1 sec. to 1/1000 sec.。使用35mm with speeds 12 to 1600 ASA。

specs.快门: Focal plane shutter made of steel lamellae, with speeds 1 sec. to 1/1000 sec.
specs.卡口: M42 screw mount with aperture release shifter and electrical contacts for aperture value transmission
specs.闪光灯: shutter flash synchronized up to speed 1/125 sec., hot shoe, PLC 3 with additional flash cable connector
specs.英文简介: The Praktica PLC 2 and PLC 3 SLR camera bodies for M42 screw mount lenses were the successors of Pentacon's Praktica LLC which was the first with the Pentacon LC light measuring system.
